figures.alt: Clean white baseboard with a precise mitered outside corner over a pale oak floor
figures.caption: Choose the profile, height, and reveal from the existing room before cutting. Baseboard should bridge wall and floor cleanly without hiding movement or damaged material.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Clean interior door-casing miters and even jamb reveal beside a finished wall
figures.caption: Cut outside corners accurately, cope inside corners where appropriate, and fasten into sound framing so the joints stay closed as the room moves through seasonal humidity.

figures.alt: Straight drywall corner bead and thin finish compound prepared on an interior wall
figures.caption: Fill fastener holes, caulk the correct joints, and seal cut ends before paint. Repair uneven drywall or loose corner material first rather than asking trim to disguise a moving surface.
